svg.desc: Four micro-batches each run forward and backward; their gradients, each weighted by its share of the examples, add up in the .grad buffers; then one optimizer step and zero_grad. The result equals the gradient of the full batch at the activation memory of one micro-batch.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gradient accumulation = a big batch in small pieces

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: k micro-batches, backward on each, ONE optimizer step.
